code:
secedit /export /cfg C:\baseline\before.inf
net accounts /lockoutthreshold:5 /lockoutduration:30 /lockoutwindow:30
secedit /export /cfg C:\baseline\after.inf
caption: A before/after export proves exactly what changed on HRU-FILE01 and HRU-APP01.

code:
Set-NetFirewallProfile -Profile Domain -DefaultInboundAction Block
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "SMB - Mgmt Subnet Only" `
  -Direction Inbound -Protocol TCP -LocalPort 445 `
  -RemoteAddress 10.20.5.0/24 -Profile Domain -Action Allow
caption: Private and Public stay at default deny -- neither server ever sits on those networks.

code:
gpupdate /force
gpresult /r
Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "SMB - Mgmt Subnet Only" | Get-NetFirewallAddressFilter
caption: Configured isn't confirmed until a command shows the change actually took effect.
